cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: The fall is the third down day unwinding a low-float squeeze after the 1-for-9 reverse split. The stock ran from about $1.87 on 09-22 to an $8.71 intraday high on 09-23, and the same day director and 10% holder Stilwell swapped Series B and D preferred for 566,670 new common shares, roughly doubling the ~568k post-split float at an implied price near $2.1. No press release or 8-K was issued on 2026-09-29 before the 15:04 ET screen.

evidence.claim: 1-for-9 reverse split effective 5:00 pm ET 2026-09-21, split-adjusted trading from 2026-09-22, approx. 568,211 shares outstanding after it

Stilwell entities received 184,655 + 257,902 + 25,516 + 35,768 + 62,829 = 566,670 common shares on 2026-09-23 in exchange for Series B and D preferred. SA got 62,829 common for 3,222 Series D, which is 19.5 common per D share. Against the $41.66 per D share redemption value in the 2026-09-09 8-K, that implies about $2.14 per common share
The 09-23 spike went to an $8.71 intraday high with a $5.44 close and was back near $3.74 by 09-25. The article attributes the move to trader flow, not news
No filing after the 2026-09-25 Form 4; the last 8-K is from 2026-09-17

pipeline.next_dated_event: Item 3.02 8-K for the 2026-09-23 exchanges, due by 2026-09-29 under the four-business-day rule and not filed as of the screen, so it lands tonight or overdue. Next after that: the Series D holder redemption on 2026-10-05 (request deadline 2026-09-25), outside the window
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An 8-K tonight showing the 09-23 exchanges were Stilwell's alone with no unaffiliated exchanges since, or a Form 4 showing Stilwell bought rather than sold, would take the supply read to zero and leave only the reaction function.

positioning_check: Nasdaq/FINRA short interest at the 2026-09-15 settlement: 258,807 shares pre-split (about 28.8k post-split), 1.0 days to cover, down 54.3% from 566,046 at 08-31 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/WHLR/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). That settlement predates the reverse split and the 09-23 squeeze. The 09-30 settlement publishes around 10-09, outside the window, so the position carried into this fall cannot be seen. No options market, so there is no skew. Float: about 568k post-split shares at 09-21 plus 566,670 issued to Stilwell on 09-23, so at least about 1.13m, plus any unaffiliated exchanges not yet disclosed.

findings.finding: The 2026-09-23 preferred-for-common exchanges, at least 566,670 new shares to Stilwell and possibly more to unaffiliated holders, need an Item 3.02 8-K by 2026-09-29. None was on EDGAR at the screen, so the full share count and any non-Stilwell exchanges become visible tonight or tomorrow.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Wheeler has filed an Item 3.02 8-K plus three 424B3 supplements for every exchange batch within 3 to 4 business days: 08-13 exchange filed 08-19, 08-28 filed 09-02, 09-02/09-03 filed 09-08. The four-business-day clock on 09-23 runs out on 09-29, today, so the filing is due inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 09-02/09-03 exchanges (841,628 pre-split shares to unaffiliated holders) were disclosed 09-08 during the Aug-Sep slide, where the baseline records falls of -36%, -15% and -18% with negative next closes. The 09-24 drop of -31.25%, the session after the Stilwell exchange, is the closest analogue, and it rebounded +39% the next day, before the Form 4 was even public. So the history on this line is mixed.
findings.why_not_priced: The Stilwell half is public through the 09-25 Form 4 and is probably in the price. What is not is whether unaffiliated preferred holders also exchanged during the 09-22 to 09-29 spike. In early September they swapped more common than the whole post-split float is now. If the tape already held a much larger count, today's fall would have come on heavy volume, not 0.78x.
findings.independence: The Form 4 filed 2026-09-25 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1527541/000121390026103642/xslF345X06/ownership.xml) independently confirms that exchanges happened on 09-23. The 2026-09-09 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1527541/000152754126000340/whlr-20260908.htm) confirms the preferred stack is still large: 1,726,704 Series D outstanding at 09-08.

outside_window.finding: Series D holder redemption on 2026-10-05 (the 37th monthly one; request deadline 2026-09-25). baseline_tension: The finding agrees with the name's own history (10 of its last 12 comparable falls were followed by a lower close) and with its extreme ATR. Volume at 0.78x cuts the other way, since light volume is the phase-0 bounce signature, and the 20-day median is inflated by the squeeze days. So the emitted -2.5 is held about 2 points short of the -4.63 history median.
